messages:
Maya (Support): FYI we have an escalated latency report from customer acme-corp. They see p95/p99 regressions on /v1/generate when using function-calls + structured output validation. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~520ms, p99 from ~1.2s -> ~3.6s. Started ~08:10 PDT. Ticket #12345.
Raj (Runtime): Got it. Do we have request IDs and example payloads? Which model and router version? Any schema size info?
Maya (Support): request_id=rt-20240422-9a1f, model=gpt-4x-infer, router=router-v2.3. Schema attached in the ticket; compiled JSON schema ~6KB, raw schema ~8KB. Structured_output=true. They hit ~200 rps.
Mike (Support): Can you paste a minimal repro curl or the body we can run locally?
Maya (Support): here is a sanitized example:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"model\":\"gpt-4x-infer\",
  \"input\":\"Summarize...\",
  \"tools\":[{\"name\":\"price_lookup\",\"schema\":{...}}],
  \"structured_output\": true
}
```
Logs show repeated lines like:
```
[2024-04-22T08:11:03Z] router: validate_schema took=42ms req=rt-20240422-9a1f tenant=acme-corp
[2024-04-22T08:11:03Z] router: dispatch_wait took=30ms req=rt-20240422-9a1f
[2024-04-22T08:11:03Z] worker: kv_cache miss
```
Lia (SRE): Host worker-7 p99 also spiked at the same time, and we see increased event loop runqueue. Might be CPU contention from sync validation.
deploy-bot: automatic alert -> high-p99-latency for tenant=acme-corp :rotating_light:
Raj (Runtime): That log is telling: `validate_schema` at ~40ms per request running inline in the router path will add up, esp at 200 rps. Also `dispatch_wait` + kv_cache misses compound latency. Quick mitigation options:
- temporary tenant override to skip strict JSON schema validation
- route this tenant to dedicated pool with express_mode to avoid queueing
- enable streaming to return early while post-validators run (if app tolerates async validation)
We can also bump the router's worker_count for a short window.
Mike (Support): How do we apply the tenant override? Need exact admin API call for support team.
Raj (Runtime): Use the admin override endpoint (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api.redwood/tenants/acme-corp/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"skip_schema_validation": true, "express_mode": true}'
```
This will skip the heavy compiled validation step and push them into express routing. Note: skipping validation risks accepting malformed tool outputs; only enable for short window.
Maya (Support): I applied `skip_schema_validation=true` and `express_mode=true` at 08:22 PDT for acme-corp. Monitoring now.
Maya (Support): Update: p95 down to ~180ms, p99 down to ~600ms after the override. Customer confirmed better responsiveness. :thumbsup:
Raj (Runtime): Good. Longer-term fixes we should track:
- move schema validation off the router hot path into an async validator service (worker pool) and only block when necessary
- memoize/compile schema validators per-tenant/schema id and cache them (avoid recompile per request)
- add a schema-size threshold that triggers lightweight validation fallback
- instrument per-tenant validation latency in Console
I'll file a runtime ticket with suggested plan.
Lia (SRE): Also add a rollback guard: if we flip `skip_schema_validation` we should monitor validation-error-rate and auto-revert after N minutes if it spikes.
Mike (Support): I added notes to ticket #12345 with the admin override steps and customer confirmation.
Raj (Runtime): Created tracker R-9876: title=\"async-schema-validator + memoized-validators\" owner=@Raj ETA=2w. Added subtasks: metrics, fallback policy, admin guard. Please add any missing risk items.
Maya (Support): tagging @Raj @Lia — I also requested a customer replay payload to test in staging, will paste results here.
Raj (Runtime): For immediate improvement we can also reduce router per-request allocations by disabling deep schema diffs: set `schema_diff=false` for this tenant until fix lands.
Maya (Support): noted, will try `schema_diff=false` if customer sees any functional regressions.
Lia (SRE): I'll monitor infra and pre-provision extra capacity for acme-corp during the rollout window.
Maya (Support): thanks team — closing loop for now, will update ticket with final customer signoff.
